headline: Going Commando adds six functions and moves blocker notes into the repo
summary: Going Commando's USA v1.01 matched code rose from 12.76% to 12.78%, with 4,144 of 8,601 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Six implementations land across game and level code, and shared blocker notes move into a document maintained through pull requests.
highlights: The final report lists PAL at 3,552 of 8,693 finished functions and USA v2.00 at 3,946 of 8,655.
#287 adds a game routine for both USA releases. #289 and #293 add five level routines.
Strict builds pass for all 84 programs across the three releases.
#288, #291, #295 and #297 remain unmerged. Retained near misses receive no progress credit.
#157 closes because its notes moved in #290 and #292, rather than because every technical blocker is solved.
